title: Guest Artist Series Residency
source_quote: Guest Artist Series for short term residency options of 1-3 months for 2026/2027. APPLICATIONS NOW CLOSED
evidence_sentence: The residency page lists available kilns but does not specify which are accessible to residents; applications are currently closed.
evidence_quote: What kind of kilns do you have? Skutt 1227 computerized electric kiln, rated to cone 8; Skutt 1027 computerized electric kiln, rated to cone 10; Skutt 822 computerized electric kiln, rated to cone 10; Skutt Glaze Tech computerized electric test kiln, rated to cone 10
summary: 1–3 month residency for emerging and established ceramic artists (2026/27). Includes 200 sq ft shared studio space, 24-hr facility access, teaching opportunities. $500/month studio rent (housing not included). Applications currently closed.
how_to_join: Applications closed; check website for next cycle
